steps.content: The two blast through the wall and charge into the oil painting section. Instead of the visitor mentioned by the navigator, they're welcomed by a large group of wandering Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Notification. The threat has been completely erased. No sign of Master has been found.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Maybe the Chief... is hiding?
The section is filled with masterpieces of the horror art exhibition.
But the duo isn't very interested in them.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Presuming. There may be more Corruptors ahead.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: And, a weak cell phone signal has been detected inside a nearby cabinet while trying to connect to the shackles.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...! Chief? Is that you?!
Just as Hecate approaches the cabinet, an eerie human voice comes out.
Bring it on, you monsters!
I'm not afraid! Not at all!
The cabinet door opens.
Stay... Stay away from me, ahhhh!!!
Wait... You're... not monsters...
Haha... Hahaha...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Snort.
As if to make it less awkward, the girl does her best to slowly move out of the cabinet without making a sound.
She holds her phone, looking embarrassed.
Of course, she's not the only one feeling embarrassed in the room.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What do you want? Why were you hiding in the cabinet?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Question. Why are you in a dangerous place like this? Are you tired of living?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Um... My name is Sasha, an outdoor live-streamer!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: I'm here because... my viewers voted for me to come. They said... it's really scary, and the show would be really great... something like that...

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: I never thought I'd run into those monsters... and there's no signal here! All this big scene going on, and I can't even do streaming!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Right, if you're able to defeat all these monsters... You must be one of those, Sinners, right? Am I right?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You don't need to know.
Hecate has no interest in the livestreamer from the cabinet, but Labyrinth on the side doesn't feel the same way.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Woah, you got it right on the first guess. 100 out of 100, Miss Sasha.
Labyrinth puts her hand to her mouth somewhat pretentiously and looks in Hecate's direction.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Oh! In that case, could you show me the thing?! The snake-like thing that was wrapped around Midsummer Night's Club last time!
The rescued girl is more interested in the duo than scared.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Shouldn't Eastsiders be afraid of Sinners?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Yeah, I used to be. But you guys saved me, and... everything about Sinners has brought me followers! People would come to my stream and talk about <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> in the comments. Why would I be afraid of you?

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: In Eastside, anything that gets people talking, big or small, is a good thing!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Aaand! This museum right now is even scarier than that giant snake!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Many monsters come out of paintings, and there are also moving statues... Including the ones you took down just now. There are other Sinners here, right?!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: To make sure I stay alive, I've decided to... stick with you guys!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: You will protect me, right? Right?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The Chief is still waiting for us, Labyrinth.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Agreed.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Judging. Completing the mission is the highest priority. Labyrinth will only protect Master.

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: Hey, where are you going?! Hey, don't leave me here! I have to record videos! What should I do without you?!

steps.speaker: Sasha
steps.content: I just took a short clip the last time, and a lot of people noticed me. I want to shoot the whole thing this time! I want everyone in Eastside to know the rookie livestreamer, Sasha, who chases thrills and excitement!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Question. Why not start dislodging?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Judging. There's a possibility of interfering with the operation.
Labyrinth mutters as she follows Hecate, leaving Sasha behind. She wants a reasonable answer, and an efficient one at that.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If Chief were here, he would make the same choice.
steps.female_content: If Chief were here, she would make the same choice.

steps.content: Hecate clearly means that the Chief will make the mission the first priority...

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Hmmm. Hope you made the right decision.
The two both speed up, leaving Sasha behind without sympathy.
